name: Stirling-PDF
description: Edit, merge, split, convert, sign and OCR PDF files in your browser.

paths.name: Configs
paths.description: Settings (settings.yml) and, with login on, the user database. Back this folder up.

paths.name: Tessdata
paths.description: OCR language files. Add more languages here.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Stirling-PDF web page and API, published on host as 6736

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN
variables.description: Set to true to need a login. The first login is admin with the password stirling, and you must pick a new password right away. Leave it false for no login on your home network.
